finalText:
**Big but shallow.** 1291 hits across 94 files.

| Must not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Frozen public contract |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) wire value | 1 | Public JSON key |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 20 | Regenerated, edits lost |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Applied history, breaks down step |
| SQL strings in `repo/*.js` | 125 | Real DB column |

That leaves 1075 plain JS names. Those rename safely. The column itself needs a new migration. Approve only if the diff skips these zones.
